services.name: 49th Annual Juried Exhibition
services.desc: For our Annual Juried Show, we welcome juror, Michele Wije, from the Yale University Art Museum. Michèle Wije is a curator and museum professional specializing in modern and contemporary art. She is currently responsible for exhibitions and curatorial affairs at the Yale University Art Gallery, where she recently curated the exhibition, Hans Hofmann. Previously, she has curated, organized, and managed exhibitions for major institutions including The Metropolitan Museum of Art, the Katonah Museum of Art, and the American Federation of Arts.
